title: Recover lazily and retain diagnostic context
summary: Attach context to parse failures, recover only on errors and transform only successful values.

resultType.clue: Return type preserving valid counts and owned diagnostic text

context.clue: Result method converting a parse error to contextual owned text

succeeded.clue: Method testing whether good is a successful result

mapping.clue: Result method doubling only the successful numeric payload

failed.clue: Method testing for a failure through a borrowed Result

diagnostic.clue: Result method converting the borrowed failure payload to an Option

recover.clue: Result method invoking the fallback closure only on failure

equal.clue: Macro checking that only one recovery closure ran

absent.clue: Value representing the absent optional number
